findings.note: Mitchell is listed at 2.4 RPG this season. The game logs show 3+ rebounds in only about 4 of 12 games, with 0–2 in most, and he shares the glass with Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo; the page has no injury flag for the Rockets game.
Nov 14: In a 39-minute win over Cleveland, Mitchell had five rebounds and 17 assists. That was his third straight game with 3+ rebounds, after three vs. Sacramento and five vs. Utah.
Nov 11: Mitchell had five rebounds in 38 minutes against Utah. The page says Spoelstra keeps him on the floor late, which points to a heavy-minutes starting role.
